name: scaffold-entity
description: Scaffolds a complete CRUD entity across every layer of the Bit.TemplatePlayground solution - entity model, EF Core configuration and migration, DTO, Mapperly mapper, API controller, IAppController interface, AppStrings resource entries, Blazor grid and add/edit pages, and navigation integration. Use when the user asks to add a new entity, add a new feature with CRUD, scaffold a table/model, or says "run scaffold" / "scaffold Product".
